name: io.github.tonyyang0504/viber-social-mcp
description: Viber (social): me, publish_text, publish_image. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_VIBER_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Viber Channel authentication token: as the channel's super admin open the Channel info screen > Developer Tools > copy token. The Channels Post API takes it as the auth_token member of every JSON request body (https://developers.viber.com/docs/tools/channels-post-api/). A webhook must have been set once with set_webhook before posting works (status 10 webhookNotSet otherwise).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_VIBER_SENDER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Viber user id of a Channel SUPER ADMIN, sent as `from` ('Only the superadmins' ID should be used as the sender ID with this API'); listed under members[] with role superadmin in get_account_info.
